title: Majorana-XYZ subsystem code
summary: Building fault-tolerant quantum computers is a current priority for the quantum computing industry and academic counterparts. We present a quantum error correction code encoding a single logical qubit into $n=L^2$ physical qubits with distance $d = L$ as a subsystem code, and $n-O(\sqrt{n})$ logical qubits with distance $d=3$ as a standard stabiliser code. The logical single-qubit gates in the subsystem code are transversal.
